Staff Full-Stack Engineer — Product Platform

We are hiring a Staff-level engineer to lead delivery across TypeScript, Node.js, React, and distributed backend services.

Must-have:
- Production TypeScript / React / Node.js experience at scale
- API design, performance, and reliability (observability, SLOs)
- Ownership of cross-team technical initiatives

Nice-to-have:
- Event-driven architecture and workflow orchestration
- PostgreSQL and AWS

You will partner with product and infrastructure to ship customer-facing features.
